sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: Once you have arrived in Finland, visit the police (poliisi.fi) or a border control authority and inform them of your intention to apply for temporary protection
Show the police or the border control authority your identity document, such as a biometric passport issued by your country of nationality, or a Ukrainian internal passport
Show also the birth certificates of your children if you have any
At present, it takes approximately 2 weeks to get a residence permit card

highlights: Applications for temporary protection are submitted to the police or border authorities

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: If you do not apply for a municipality of residence, you will continue to be a client of a reception centre and will continue to receive services from your reception centre

sources.title: enb.fi
highlights: Migri's current estimate is that a complete application is processed in about a week; the decision then takes roughly another week to arrive by post, so it usually reaches you within two weeks
Migri says the card takes about two weeks and is sent to a collection point within three weeks of the decision
These are estimates: a missing document or a request for further information lengthens them
